ios.desc:
A literary companion for those who find meaning in language. It generates an endless, personalised stream of original poetry — composed entirely on your device, in silence.
Powered by a state-of-the-art on-device language model, Poetical draws inspiration from a vast and ever-changing source: the collective knowledge that is available under the public domain. Each poem begins from a seed — a random article, a historical figure, a distant place, a forgotten idea, an object — and is transformed, through the craft of artificial intelligence, into verse.

KEY FEATURES
- Infinite stream of original poems, no two verses are ever the same
- Ten poetic forms such as Haiku, Sonnet, Free Verse, Ode, Elegy, Villanelle, Tanka, Ghazal, Ballad, and Prose Poem
- Fully on‑device generation, advance model runs locally; your reading habits remain entirely private
- Inspiration, each poem is rooted in real-world knowledge, lending it depth and particularity

FREE
 One poem per hour limitation.

SUBSCRIPTION
 Uninterrupted access to endless poetry.

PRIVACY FIRST
Requires no account, collects no data, and performs all inference locally on your device. The model is downloaded once and stored privately. 

Best experienced slowly, and preferably in quiet.

Visit https://elvure.app
